# What does Bandcamp actually leave you on each sale?

> Free analyzer for Bandcamp artists and labels: drop in your sales report CSV and see fees paid, net per item, small-sale fee drag, vinyl and merch profit after your costs, best releases and repeat buyers. Runs in your browser, the file is never uploaded.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
